title_en: Palestinians turn to communal ovens to bake bread in Gaza
excerpt_en: Amid Gaza’s food crisis, bread remains a staple as displaced families use communal ovens to save on costly fuel.

title_en: Attempted murder for the man who shot three Palestinians in Vermont
excerpt_en: Jason Eaton was found guilty of attempted second-degree murder for the shooting of three Palestinian college students.

title_en: Why does the US want to send Israel 40,000 bombs?
excerpt_en: Is the planned $2.8bn US arms deal proportionate to Israel’s threat, or could it cause more civilian casualties in Gaza?

title_en: US blocks Palestinian leader from UN meeting in New York for second year in row
excerpt_en: The US State Department extended visa sanctions after accusing Palestinian officials of failing to live up to peace process commitments.

title_en: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
excerpt_en: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

title_en: Gaza: At least 20 killed in deadly building collapse, search for survivors continues
excerpt_en: Search and rescue operations continued in Gaza City on Wednesday following the collapse of a bombed-out building that killed at least 20 people, according to reports.

title_en: Gaza remains recovery points to possible war crimes, says UN rights chief
excerpt_en: Bodies are still being pulled from the rubble of Gaza, three years after Israeli bombardment flattened entire neighbourhoods – most of them women and children.

title_en: ‘Where do we go?’: How Israel’s ‘yellow line’ is closing in on Palestinians
excerpt_en: Ola Ishtiwi sits with her children in front of the remains of her home in the Al-Tuffah neighbourhood in eastern Gaza City, a few metres away from a series of painted cement blocks Israel has placed to mark what has become known as the “yellow line”.

title_en: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
excerpt_en: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.

title_en: In Gaza, women-headed households face ‘impossible choices’ to survive
excerpt_en: In war-torn Gaza, a growing number of women-headed households face “impossible decisions” every day, amid ongoing Israeli airstrikes and still-scarce resources, UN humanitarians said on Tuesday.

title_en: West Bank: UN rights report warns of forcible displacement from three refugee camps
excerpt_en: Israeli security forces forcibly displaced the entire population of three Palestine refugee camps in the occupied West Bank in January and February last year – and continue to prevent their return, in violation of international law, according to a new report by the UN human rights office, OHCHR.

title_en: Lebanon–Israel tensions escalate as Gaza sees major aid delivery
excerpt_en: Peacekeepers in Lebanon have reported a marked deterioration in the security situation along the Blue Line of separation, with Israeli forces intensifying their military footprint in violation of a landmark Security Council resolution, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Thursday.
